name: qkd_static_ectla_k3rc-r3rc-COMMIT
purpose: ECTLA-2 2026-10-17 (coordinator 0co (1): k1 qkd_static_ectla_kiss REJECTED at review: TT clock insertion 350 ps, W landing face 1,100 pins at 8.5/um, SRAMs off the 43.2 lattice in x, two std-cell bands). Structural re-plan, same child RTL and cycles (ROW_RETURN_LAT = RESPONSE_LAT + 7): outline re-aspected inside the KV die's ECTL slot to 172.8 x 194.4 (4 x 4.5 lattice; the tile is pin-limited: 2.1k um2 std + 7.8k um2 SRAM); both SRAMs stacked in ONE column on the lattice (x 43.2, y 43.2 / 129.6) with their pin edge (W) facing ONE contiguous std-cell band (landing capture, issuer, ECTL body); the E strip carries only the rs_o / x_i pin flops; W landing 1,100 pins over 190 um (5.8/um, M4 + M6); E rs_o / x_i at the grant's exact y (B abuts bottom-aligned); t0_row (S) / t1_row (N) over x 23..170 (3.5/um). Clock: two REGIONAL CTS roots (multiple_cts_roots, same PLL 1:1 phase 0, ordinary STA on every rq/rs crossing): ck_k (W face middle, y 97) clocks only the K issuer = the W landing band (1,025-b rs capture + request/identity flops) with its own regional reset rst_k; ck (N face centre, x 86) clocks the ECTL A body (row ring, both SRAMs, N/S row flops, E rs_o/x_i flops). The die delivers the same clock and reset at both entries (re-grant noted in HANDOFF).
